import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}address-states`;// Get States
const getAddressStates=async access_token=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,config);return response.data;};// Delete 
const deleteAddressState=async(addressStateId,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+'/'+addressStateId,config);return response.data;};const updateAddressState=async(addressStateId,addressStateData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+'/'+addressStateId,addressStateData,config);return response.data;};// Create 
const createAddressState=async(addressStateData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,addressStateData,config);return response.data;};const batchDeleteAddressStates=async(addressStatesIds,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL+'/batch-delete',addressStatesIds,config);return response.data;};const addressStateService={createAddressState,getAddressStates,deleteAddressState,updateAddressState,batchDeleteAddressStates};export default addressStateService;
